name: Keeper Eluned

intro.text: Shwmae. Mind the hard hat rule. Yes, even you. Especially you.
Eluned. I look after the Stone Stone, and the quarry it came out of. Both are heavier than they look.
I don't do speeches. Show me what you've got and we'll see how well it's bedded in.

win: Wel, dyna ni. Solid work. Not a crack in it. Take the Stone, and mind where you put it down.
after: Slate lasts a hundred years if you treat it right. People, rather less, but you seem sturdy. Hwyl.
